name: Refuge Pointe
summary: Refuge Pointe holds its ground in the Arathi Highlands as Stromgarde's remnant prepares to reclaim its fallen keep. The camp guards the trade road at the highlands' heart while Alliance forces face rivals across the region.

sections.title: A Bastion for Stromgarde's Remnants
sections.body: Stromgarde's surviving soldiers hold Refuge Pointe. After the Third War and the fall of Stromgarde Keep, most of the kingdom's people fled south for safer lands. Those who stayed formed a vanguard under Captain Nials. Battle-hardened Stromgarde soldiers stand with League of Arathor forces and Alliance specialists. Together, they are the last organized Stromgarde force in its ancestral homeland.

sections.title: Stretched to the Limit
sections.body:
Refuge Pointe has no reserves to spare. The Forsaken and Horde hold Hammerfall, while Witherbark trolls, Syndicate rogues, and Boulderfist ogres press the garrison from other sides. When dwarven commanders at battered Thandol Span asked for help against the Dark Iron clan, Captain Nials had to refuse.

Every soldier and supply at Refuge Pointe must defend the highlands and prepare to retake Stromgarde Keep.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance presence here so small?
faq.answer: Most of Stromgarde's surviving civilians fled south after the kingdom fell in the Third War. The small force at Refuge Pointe is a remnant of its army, joined by an Alliance expedition. With supplies stretched thin and enemies on every front, they struggle to hold their camp.

faq.q: Why won't Refuge Pointe send soldiers to help at the Thandol Span?
faq.answer: Captain Nials refused the dwarves' request for troops to defend Dun Modr and Thandol Span from Dark Iron attacks. Stromgarde Keep is overrun, and hostile forces surround Refuge Pointe. Every soldier must help hold the highlands and prepare to reclaim the fallen capital.
Captain Nials commands Refuge Pointe's garrison. She directs Stromgarde's operations across the highlands, from scouting and skirmishes with the Syndicate and ogres to patrols along the main road.

faq.q: What is the League of Arathor?
faq.answer: The League of Arathor is an Alliance coalition seeking to reclaim the Arathi Highlands and secure resources in neighboring Arathi Basin. Its forces fight beside Stromgarde's remnant at Refuge Pointe to keep the Forsaken-led Defilers from controlling the fertile valley.

angles.text: Refuge Pointe is your military sanctuary and flight hub in the Arathi Highlands. Here, you find relief in a territory contested by ogres, the Syndicate, and the Horde.
As a human, you can look to Refuge Pointe and remember Stromgarde's former glory as humanity's martial heartland. Its defenders refuse to abandon their homeland despite overwhelming odds.
